## Capability

A third body of content bound at more than one activity, so what a holding context already has is
more than what a single delivery collapses against itself.

## Outputs

### recorded_note

What the record step wrote down.

## Protocol

### 1. Write It Down

- Write what this stop settled under `{recorded_note}`.
- Bound once per activity rather than twice, so it adds to what a LATER delivery collapses without
  adding to what the first collapses on its own.

## Rules

### one-record-per-stop

A stop records once. Two records in one stop would change the floor this fixture is sized against.
